items.title: Don Menza and Sam Noto interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 28, 1997
items.q: Dr. Jewett is the man — remember Jewett Hall? He invented the orthopedic pin.

ctx.x: There was no question in my mind. Well I was sort of misled. I didn’t have enough money to go to one of the bigger universities. I didn’t want to go to North Texas State, for some reason I didn’t want to be that far from the east, from New York. I’m a New Yorker and I’m not particularly thrilled about the fact that I moved to California. It was very good to me but getting to New York and being in the thick of it — feeling all of those jazz players around you, there was so much history there man, I couldn’t wait…
“You wouldn’t even let me back in and now—”
